$comment: Tracer pre-render config for mermaid-cli (mmdc). Produces dark-theme static SVG matching tracer.css tokens (Tracer is dark-first; IBM Carbon dark palette). Usage: npx -y @mermaid-js/mermaid-cli -i diagram.mmd -o diagram.svg --configFile mermaid-config.json --backgroundColor transparent. Pre-rendered SVG is single-theme by nature — pin its figure to the dark ground (#161616) so it stays readable if the page is viewed light. Native trace diagrams (spec §6) are preferred; Mermaid is for sequence/state/ER/gantt only. Keep in sync with the default token block in tracer.css.
fontFamily: IBM Plex Sans, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Segoe UI, system-ui, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
